functions.name: guard_general_grant()
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_general_grant()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE b jsonb; cid text; alpha boolean; standing boolean; predecessor provider_grants; lineage text[];
BEGIN
 IF NEW.data->>'profile'<>'general-responses-v1' THEN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM general_grant_continuations WHERE successor_id=NEW.id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'alpha successor required'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 b=NEW.data->'responses';
 alpha=b ? 'runtime_extension'; standing=coalesce(b->>'admission_policy'='principal-workspace-v1',false);
      IF b ? 'admission_policy' AND NOT standing THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown admission policy'; END IF;
      IF standing AND NOT alpha THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing alpha binding required'; END IF;
 IF alpha THEN
   PERFORM require_alpha_budget_binding(b);
   IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.data->'max_runs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
      OR coalesce(NEW.data->>'max_runs','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
      OR NEW.data->'max_received_output_tokens' IS DISTINCT FROM '16384'::jsonb
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact typed alpha run bounds required'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.data->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id OR NEW.data->>'workspace_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workspace_id
 OR NEW.data->>'principal_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.principal_id
 OR NEW.data->'expires_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR NEW.data->>'model' IS DISTINCT FROM 'gpt-6.1-sol'
 OR coalesce((NEW.data->>'max_runs')::integer,0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE WHEN standing THEN 256 WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN 10 ELSE 4 END)
 OR NEW.data->>'max_received_output_tokens' IS DISTINCT FROM '16384'
 OR b->>'policy_version' NOT IN ('general-responses-v1','adaptive-local-v1')
 OR (b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' AND coalesce((b->>'max_steps')::integer,0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE WHEN alpha THEN 8 ELSE 4 END))
 OR (NOT alpha AND (b->>'generation_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN '50' ELSE '8' END) OR b->>'count_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN '50' ELSE '8' END)
 OR b->>'read_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN '500' ELSE '80' END) OR b->>'cancel_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'
 OR (b->'input_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN 1000000 ELSE 160000 END)
       AND b->'input_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN 2500000 ELSE 400000 END)) OR b->>'output_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b->>'policy_version'='adaptive-local-v1' THEN '409600' ELSE '65536' END)
 OR b->>'cost_limit_usd' IS DISTINCT FROM '20.00'))
 OR b->>'synthetic_data_only' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR b->>'store_acknowledged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR b->>'authorization_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'd7f676d970ef2c6d56c39fe961114d00140279b99ba72649177c41de159093c9'
 OR jsonb_typeof(b->'conversation_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR (NOT standing AND jsonb_array_length(b->'conversation_ids') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE WHEN alpha THEN 10 ELSE 2 END))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact bounded general authorization required'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   SELECT g.* INTO predecessor FROM general_grant_continuations l
     JOIN provider_grants g ON g.id=l.predecessor_id WHERE l.successor_id=NEW.id;
   IF FOUND THEN
     -- New immutable pins may change; scope/route cannot. This is a continuation
     -- grant, not an implicit request for additional accounts, data or effects.
     IF NOT alpha OR predecessor.active
        OR predecessor.workspace_id<>NEW.workspace_id OR predecessor.principal_id<>NEW.principal_id
        OR predecessor.data->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'general-responses-v1'
        OR predecessor.data->'responses'->>'runtime_extension' IS DISTINCT FROM 'general-alpha-v1'
        OR predecessor.data->>'model' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.data->>'model'
        OR (NOT standing AND predecessor.data->'responses'->'conversation_ids' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'conversation_ids')
      OR (NOT standing AND predecessor.data->'responses'->'admission_policy' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'admission_policy')
        OR predecessor.data->'responses'->'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'project_id'
        OR predecessor.data->'responses'->'transport_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'transport_mode'
        OR predecessor.data->'responses'->'secret_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'secret_reference'
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inactive exact-scope same-route alpha predecessor required'; END IF;
     WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS (
       SELECT predecessor.id UNION ALL
       SELECT l.predecessor_id FROM general_grant_continuations l JOIN ancestors a ON l.successor_id=a.id
     ) SELECT array_agg(id) INTO lineage FROM ancestors;
   END IF;
 END IF;
 IF standing AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
         IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
                        AND principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND active AND role IN ('owner','editor'))
         THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing principal membership required'; END IF;
         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_grants g WHERE g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
             AND g.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND g.data->>'profile'='general-responses-v1'
             AND (g.data->'responses'->'project_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'project_id'
               OR g.data->'responses'->'transport_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM b->'transport_mode'))
         THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing admission cannot reset historical project accounting'; END IF;
         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_grants g WHERE g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
             AND g.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND g.data->'responses'->>'admission_policy'='principal-workspace-v1'
             AND (g.active OR NOT (g.id=ANY(coalesce(lineage,ARRAY[]::text[])))))
         THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing authorization requires explicit inactive lineage'; END IF;
       END IF;
       FOR cid IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(b->'conversation_ids') LOOP
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations cv WHERE cv.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND cv.id=cid
      AND cv.data->>'owner_id'=NEW.principal_id AND cv.data->'selected_source_refs'='[]'::jsonb)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit synthetic conversation scope required'; END IF;
   IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_grants g WHERE g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
      AND g.data->>'profile'='general-responses-v1' AND g.data->'responses'->'conversation_ids' ? cid
      AND (g.active OR NOT (g.id=ANY(coalesce(lineage,ARRAY[]::text[])))))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversation authorization requires explicit inactive lineage'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

functions.name: require_alpha_budget_binding(jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_alpha_budget_binding(b jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF b ? 'continuity_version' AND b->'continuity_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '"sustained-v1"'::jsonb
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known explicit continuity version required'; END IF;
 PERFORM require_alpha_budget_binding_pre_continuity(b-'continuity_version');
END; $function$

functions.name: require_alpha_budget_binding_pre_continuity(jsonb)
require_scoped_alpha_budget_binding(jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_scoped_alpha_budget_binding(b jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE k text; ceiling numeric;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR b->'runtime_extension' IS DISTINCT FROM '"general-alpha-v1"'::jsonb
    OR b->'policy_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '"adaptive-local-v1"'::jsonb
    OR b->'cancel_limit' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
    OR b->'synthetic_data_only' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR b->'store_acknowledged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR jsonb_typeof(b->'max_steps') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR coalesce(b->>'max_steps','') !~ '^[1-8]$'
    OR jsonb_typeof(b->'cost_limit_usd') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR coalesce(b->>'cost_limit_usd','') !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]?)(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$'
    OR jsonb_typeof(b->'conversation_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR b - ARRAY['runtime_extension','project_id','secret_reference','transport_mode','instructions_sha256',
       'schema_sha256','scope_tool_sha256','policy_version','max_steps','generation_limit','count_limit',
       'read_limit','cancel_limit','input_limit','output_limit','cost_limit_usd','conversation_ids',
       'authorization_sha256','synthetic_data_only','store_acknowledged'] <> '{}'::jsonb
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact typed alpha budget binding required'; END IF;
 IF (b->>'cost_limit_usd')::numeric>20.00
    OR jsonb_array_length(b->'conversation_ids') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b->'conversation_ids'))<>jsonb_array_length(b->'conversation_ids')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(b->'conversation_ids') v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
       OR length(v #>> '{}') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128 OR (v #>> '{}') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*$')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded unique alpha scope required'; END IF;
 FOREACH k IN ARRAY ARRAY['generation_limit','count_limit','read_limit','input_limit','output_limit'] LOOP
   ceiling=CASE k WHEN 'generation_limit' THEN 256 WHEN 'count_limit' THEN 256 WHEN 'read_limit' THEN 4096
       WHEN 'input_limit' THEN 12800000 ELSE 2097152 END;
   IF jsonb_typeof(b->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(b->>k,'') !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact typed alpha budget binding required'; END IF;
   IF (b->>k)::numeric>ceiling THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'alpha budget may only tighten'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH k IN ARRAY ARRAY['instructions_sha256','schema_sha256','scope_tool_sha256','authorization_sha256'] LOOP
   IF jsonb_typeof(b->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(b->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact alpha pins required'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_typeof(b->'project_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(b->>'project_id','') !~ '^proj_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$'
    OR jsonb_typeof(b->'secret_reference') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(b->>'secret_reference','') !~ '^file:/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$'
    OR length(b->>'secret_reference') NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 406
    OR b->'transport_mode' NOT IN ('"synthetic"'::jsonb,'"official_api"'::jsonb) OR NOT b ? 'transport_mode'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact alpha route binding required'; END IF;
END; $function$

functions.name: guard_responses_event()
guard_carried_budget_event()
responses_budget_grants(text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.responses_budget_grants(gid text)
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT g.id FROM provider_grants g JOIN provider_grants original ON original.id=gid
 WHERE g.data->'responses'->>'transport_mode'=original.data->'responses'->>'transport_mode'
 AND (g.data->'responses'->>'project_id'=original.data->'responses'->>'project_id'
   OR (original.data->'responses'->>'authorization_sha256' IS NOT NULL
       AND g.data->'responses'->>'authorization_sha256'=original.data->'responses'->>'authorization_sha256'
       AND original.data->'responses'->>'transport_mode'='official_api'))
$function$
